Cap Raise Crucible: Canaccord leads big mining dash for cash

The Cap Raise Crucible saw ASX cheque books well and truly remain open as over 35 raisings chased $687.5M, led by big mining books. Canaccord was at the pointy end with nine mandates worth $380M.
